_meta.description: Reach-overflow state for the 2021 DIANMU event, from REPORTED river-gauge peaks (upgraded from mechanism-inference in A2, 2026-07-27).
_meta.evidence_basis: C.2 Nakhon Sawan peaked ~3,000-3,100 m3/s (22 Oct 2564) — above channel capacity 2,840 -> RR-CP-UPPER overflow. Chao Phraya Dam (C.13) released ~2,700-2,800 m3/s (at/near the 2,800 downstream flood threshold); lower Chao Phraya provinces (Chai Nat/Sing Buri/Ang Thong/Ayutthaya) flooded. Ping/Nan main stems stayed low (Tak only 2,208 rai; Phitsanulok flooded from the Yom sub-basin, not in graph).
_meta.confidence: based on reported peaks (news/RID); slightly lower than 2022's single-day RID bulletin but no longer pure inference
